metadata.name: cow_settlement
metadata.description: CoW Protocol settlement program. Some of the properties and instructions of this program can't be represented via a standard IDL, please be careful to read the documentation on the function you are using. Both the program and this IDL are in early release phase and may contain errors.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the singleton settlement state PDA. Succeeds only once.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the state PDA's rent and pays the transaction fee.

accounts.name: state_pda
docs: Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

args.name: manager
docs: The initial holder of the Manager role: the account authorized to add and remove solvers and to transfer any role.

args.name: reclaim_authority
docs: The initial holder of the ReclaimAuthority role: the account authorized to close buffer accounts and reclaim their rent.

instructions.name: create_buffer
docs: Creates one or more per-token buffer PDAs (SPL token accounts) in a single instruction.

IDL LIMITATION: the real instruction accepts an unbounded number of (buffer_pda, mint) pairs as remaining accounts, one pair per buffer, with at least one pair required (CreateBuffer rejects zero buffers). IDL grammar has no 'repeated group' construct, so this file only declares the guaranteed index-0 template (buffer_pda_0/mint_0).
Each buffer_pda_i must be the canonical PDA for seeds [SETTLEMENT_SEED, mint_i, "buffer"].

accounts.name: buffer_pda_0
docs: Guaranteed present: CreateBuffer rejects an instruction with zero buffers.

accounts.name: mint_0
docs: Guaranteed present: CreateBuffer rejects an instruction with zero buffers.

instructions.name: create_order
docs: Allocates a per-order PDA and writes the initial OrderAccount body.

order_pda's canonical seeds are [SETTLEMENT_SEED, sha256(intent_bytes), "order"]. This is not expressible as a static `pda` entry because the middle seed is a hash of the entire `intent` argument, not a plain field/account reference, which is outside what the PDA-seed grammar can describe.
The intent's created_on_chain flag must be set: this instruction implements that authentication scheme, and an intent flagged for off-chain Ed25519 authentication is rejected.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Must match intent.owner; authenticates the order.

accounts.name: created_by
docs: Funds the new order PDA's rent.

accounts.name: order_pda
docs: See the seed-derivation note above; cannot be auto-derived by IDL-driven tooling.

instructions.name: begin_settle
docs: Pulls funds for a batch of orders. Must be paired in the same transaction with a FinalizeSettle at `finalize_ix_index`.

IDL LIMITATION: only the fixed-size prefix (finalize_ix_index, auction_id) is represented as typed arguments. After it, the real wire format is `[order_count: u8][transfer_count; order_count][amount: u64 LE; sum(transfer_count)]`. Please check the rust documentation for more information.

accounts.name: solver
docs: The solver settling this batch. Must be present in the state PDA's solver list; only a registered solver may settle.

accounts.name: state_pda
docs: Must be the canonical state PDA; holds the solver list `solver` is checked against, and signs each pull as the user's SPL delegate.

args.name: finalize_ix_index
docs: Index of the paired FinalizeSettle in this transaction. Little-endian, matching standard Borsh/Anchor u16 decoding.

args.name: auction_id
docs: The off-chain auction this settlement executes. Carried in the instruction data so the settlement can be tied back to its auction off-chain, unused on-chain.

instructions.name: finalize_settle
docs: Validates that a BeginSettle at `begin_ix_index` exists and points back at this instruction. Must not be called via CPI.

IDL LIMITATION: only the fixed-size prefix (begin_ix_index) is represented as a typed argument. After it, the real wire format is `[bump: u8; push_count][amount: u64 LE; push_count]`, where each bump is the canonical bump of the push's source buffer PDA. Please check the rust documentation for more information.

accounts.name: state_pda
docs: Must be the canonical state PDA; signs each push as the buffers' SPL token authority.

args.name: begin_ix_index
docs: Index of the paired BeginSettle in this transaction. Little-endian, matching standard Borsh/Anchor u16 decoding.

instructions.name: reclaim_order
docs: Closes an expired order PDA and returns its rent lamports to the created_by account recorded in the order body. The instruction may only be executed after the order's valid_to timestamp has elapsed.
An order created on-chain is reclaimable earlier than that: as soon as it has been cancelled or completely filled, without waiting for valid_to.
No signature requirement: anyone may reclaim an expired order on behalf of its reclaim_recipient.

accounts.name: order_pda
docs: The order PDA to close. Its canonical bump is read out of the stored OrderAccount body, so no bump argument is needed.

accounts.name: reclaim_recipient
docs: Must match the created_by address recorded in the order; receives the recovered rent lamports.

instructions.name: reclaim_buffer
docs: Closes one or more buffer PDAs and sends each closed buffer's rent lamports to a reclaim_recipient of the caller's choosing. Only the current holder of the ReclaimAuthority role recorded in the state PDA may authorize this. A buffer that still holds tokens is skipped, not closed, and the instruction still succeeds.

IDL LIMITATION: the real instruction accepts an unbounded number of (buffer_pda, mint) pairs as remaining accounts, one pair per buffer, with at least one pair required (ReclaimBuffer rejects zero buffers). IDL grammar has no 'repeated group' construct, so this file only declares the guaranteed index-0 template (buffer_pda_0/mint_0).
Each buffer_pda_i must be the canonical PDA for seeds [SETTLEMENT_SEED, mint_i, "buffer"]; mint_i is passed only so that derivation can be checked on-chain.

accounts.name: state_pda
docs: Must be the canonical state PDA; holds the reclaim_authority the signer is checked against, and is the buffers' SPL token authority. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

accounts.name: reclaim_authority
docs: Must match the reclaim_authority address recorded in the state PDA.

accounts.name: reclaim_recipient
docs: Receives the rent lamports of every closed buffer.

accounts.name: buffer_pda_0
docs: Guaranteed present: ReclaimBuffer rejects an instruction with zero buffers.

accounts.name: mint_0
docs: Guaranteed present: ReclaimBuffer rejects an instruction with zero buffers.

instructions.name: transfer_authority
docs: Transfers one Role stored in the state PDA to another account in a single step: the signer names the new holder and the role's holder is updated immediately.
The signer must be either the manager or the current holder of the role being transferred.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Authorizes the transfer; must be the manager or the current holder of `role`.

accounts.name: state_pda
docs: Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

args.name: role
docs: The role to transfer, as its single wire discriminator byte.

args.name: new_authority
docs: Becomes the holder of `role` once the instruction succeeds.

instructions.name: add_solver
docs: Registers a solver, inserting it into the sorted solver list stored in the state PDA. Only the current holder of the Manager role may authorize this, and a solver that is already registered is rejected.
The state PDA grows by one address, so the payer tops up its rent through a system-program transfer.

accounts.name: manager
docs: Must match the manager address recorded in the state PDA. Authorizes the change but doesn't pay for it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the rent of the state PDA's extra solver slot.

accounts.name: state_pda
docs: Holds the manager the signer is checked against and the solver list the new solver is inserted into; grown by one address. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

args.name: solver
docs: The account to register as a solver.

instructions.name: remove_solver
docs: Removes a solver, deleting it from the sorted solver list stored in the state PDA. Only the current holder of the Manager role may authorize this, and a solver that isn't registered is rejected.
EXPERIMENT: the state PDA is not resized and no rent is refunded, so its data and lamports only ever grow across add/remove cycles.

accounts.name: manager
docs: Must match the manager address recorded in the state PDA. Authorizes the change but doesn't receive anything.

accounts.name: state_pda
docs: Holds the manager the signer is checked against and the solver list the removed solver is taken from. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

args.name: solver
docs: The solver to remove.

types.name: OrderAccount
docs: Idiomatic representation of an order PDA's body.

types.name: SettlementState
docs: The parameters used to initialize the state account. They are also the account's stored header, in wire order.

IDL LIMITATION: the sorted list of approved solvers that follows the header isn't declared here. It's a bare run of 32-byte addresses filling the rest of the account, with no length prefix for a vec type to read. add_solver inserts into it, keeping it sorted ascending by address so that it stays binary-searchable.

types.name: OrderIntent
docs: Canonical order intent. Also the exact bytes hashed (SHA-256) to produce the order UID used in the order PDA's seeds,
and the exact wire format of create_order's `intent` argument. Field order and encoding here are load-bearing: they
must match this program's Rust definition exactly.

fields.name: flags
docs: IDL LIMITATION: this byte packs three settings the IDL's type grammar can't name as one field, so it's declared as the raw byte the wire carries. Bit 0 is created_on_chain: set when the order is authenticated by its owner signing a create_order instruction, clear when it's authenticated by an off-chain Ed25519 signature. Bit 1 is the OrderKind (0 = Sell, 1 = Buy). Bit 2 is partially_fillable.
Every other bit is reserved and must be clear: the program rejects a flags byte carrying one, so the same settings never have two encodings, and an order never has two UIDs.

types.name: OrderKind
docs: Direction of the trade. The discriminants are the values the kind bit of the encoded flags byte takes.

types.name: Role
docs: A transferable authority stored in the state PDA.
The discriminant is the wire value carried by the authority-transfer
instruction (see transfer_authority).

errors.name: FinalizeBeforeInitialize
errors.msg: The FinalizeSettle included as input to BeginSettle isn't before the actual BeginSettle index.

errors.name: BeginFinalizePairOverlap
errors.msg: Another BeginSettle/FinalizeSettle of this program appears strictly between this pair's bounds, nesting or overlapping two settlements.

errors.name: MissingCounterpartInstruction
errors.msg: The counterpart index points past the end of the transaction's instruction list, so no instruction sits there.

errors.name: CounterpartIsExternal
errors.msg: The instruction at the counterpart index belongs to a different program.

errors.name: InvalidCounterpartDiscriminator
errors.msg: The counterpart instruction's discriminator byte couldn't be recovered from its data.

errors.name: InvalidCounterpartCounterpart
errors.msg: The counterpart instruction's own counterpart index couldn't be recovered from its data.

errors.name: MismatchedCounterpartDiscriminator
errors.msg: The counterpart's discriminator isn't the expected BeginSettle/FinalizeSettle kind, or its counterpart index doesn't point back at this instruction.

errors.name: OwnerMismatch
errors.msg: CreateOrder instruction wasn't signed by the created OrderIntent owner.

errors.name: AccountNotDerivable
errors.msg: An account was provided that cannot be derived from the seeds recognized by the program

errors.name: OrdersNotStrictlyIncreasing
errors.msg: BeginSettle's order accounts aren't passed strictly increasing by address.

errors.name: SellTokenAccountMismatch
errors.msg: A BeginSettle sell token account doesn't match the sell_token_account recorded in the order's intent.

errors.name: SellTokenAccountInvalid
errors.msg: A BeginSettle sell token account isn't a valid SPL token account (wrong data length or not owned by the token program).

errors.name: SellTokenOwnerMismatch
errors.msg: A BeginSettle sell token account's SPL owner isn't the order's intent owner.

errors.name: AccountCountNotMatchingOrderCount
errors.msg: BeginSettle's order-account count doesn't match the structure its instruction data expects: n orders each contribute an order PDA and a sell token account, plus one destination account per transfer.

errors.name: CalledViaCpi
errors.msg: BeginSettle or FinalizeSettle was invoked via CPI rather than as a top-level transaction instruction.

errors.name: OrderCancelled
errors.msg: A BeginSettle order has been cancelled by its owner and can no longer be settled.

errors.name: OrderExpired
errors.msg: A BeginSettle order's valid_to lies in the past: the order has expired and can no longer be settled.

errors.name: TransferCountMismatch
errors.msg: The transfer counts in BeginSettle don't sum to the number of transfer amounts, so destinations and amounts can't be paired up exactly.

errors.name: StateAccountMismatch
errors.msg: BeginSettle's state account isn't the canonical settlement state PDA, which must sign the pulls as the user's token delegate.

errors.name: AccountCountNotMatchingPushCount
errors.msg: FinalizeSettle's push-account count doesn't match its instruction data: each push contributes a source buffer and a destination account, so the count must be twice the number of push amounts.

errors.name: SettledOrderPushCountMismatch
errors.msg: BeginSettle: the number of pushes carried by the paired FinalizeSettle doesn't equal the number of settled orders. Each order must be paid by exactly one push.

errors.name: PushDestinationMismatch
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a paired FinalizeSettle push doesn't send its proceeds to the order's buy token account; its destination differs from the buy_token_account in the order's intent.

errors.name: PushSourceNotBuffer
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a paired FinalizeSettle push doesn't draw funds from the canonical buffer for the order's buy_mint.

errors.name: SellMintMismatch
errors.msg: BeginSettle: the OrderIntent sell_token_account holds a different mint than the declared sell_mint.

errors.name: LimitPriceViolated
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a settled order's executed price (amount_out/amount_in) is worse than the order's limit price (buy_amount/sell_amount).

errors.name: PullAmountOverflow
errors.msg: BeginSettle: an order's pull amounts sum to more than u64::MAX.

errors.name: FillExceedsOrderAmount
errors.msg: BeginSettle: filling this order would consume more tokens than the maximum the user is willing to trade on this intent. Sell: amount_in > sell_amount; buy: amount_out > buy_amount.

errors.name: OrderNotExactlyFilled
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a non-partially_fillable order isn't filled exactly to its amount (either under- or over-filled). Sell: amount_in != sell_amount; buy: total amount_out != buy_amount.

errors.name: AmountWithdrawnOverflow
errors.msg: BeginSettle: the order's cumulative amount_withdrawn would exceed u64::MAX once this settlement's pulls are added.

errors.name: AmountReceivedOverflow
errors.msg: BeginSettle: the order's cumulative amount_received would exceed u64::MAX once this settlement's push is added.

errors.name: OrderNotReclaimable
errors.msg: ReclaimOrder was called on an order that has is not yet eligible for reclaim.

errors.name: ReclaimRecipientMismatch
errors.msg: ReclaimOrder's reclaim_recipient account doesn't match the created_by address recorded in the order.

errors.name: ReclaimAuthorityMismatch
errors.msg: ReclaimBuffer's reclaim_authority account isn't a signer, or doesn't match the reclaim_authority address recorded in the settlement state PDA.

errors.name: ReclaimBufferNotCanonical
errors.msg: A ReclaimBuffer buffer_pda doesn't sit at the canonical buffer PDA derived from its paired mint.

errors.name: UnauthorizedAuthorityTransfer
errors.msg: TransferAuthority's signer is neither the manager nor the current holder of the role being transferred, so it may not transfer it.

errors.name: UnauthorizedSolverManagement
errors.msg: AddSolver/RemoveSolver's manager account isn't a signer, or doesn't match the manager recorded in the settlement state PDA, so it may not change the solver list.

errors.name: SolverAlreadyExists
errors.msg: AddSolver's solver is already in the state PDA's solver list.

errors.name: UnauthorizedSolver
errors.msg: BeginSettle's solver account isn't a signer or isn't in the state PDA's solver list, so it may not settle.

errors.name: SolverNotFound
errors.msg: RemoveSolver's solver isn't in the state PDA's solver list.

errors.name: OrderCreatedOnChainMismatch
errors.msg: A created order's intent isn't set with the created_on_chain flag corresponding to the behavior of the invoked order creation instruction.
